experienceChange.title: Mobile navigation and usability polish
experienceChange.assessedScope: Shared v10 navigation shell, responsive CSS, homepage small-screen presentation, company support contact and regression coverage.
experienceChange.observedDefect: On the owner’s Android production review, the menu icon changed to X but the links remained hidden; the support label and address lacked clear separation.
experienceChange.rootCause: Legacy responsive link-hiding selectors were still applying to the v10 primary navigation.
experienceChange.evidenceBoundary: This patch corrects observed navigation and presentation defects. It does not claim independent accessibility certification, universal device compatibility or improved conversion.

focusedExperienceAndSecurityGate.command: NODE_ENV=test node --test tests/access-control.test.js tests/runtime-policy.test.js tests/control-plane.test.js tests/customer-journey.test.js tests/experience-design.test.js

browserSourceCheck.environment: Headless Chromium with in-memory exact HTML, CSS and module shell

detectionBenchmark.scope: Small internal synthetic English regression set; not independent or production-representative.

limitations: The automated gate excludes production credentials and does not connect to production PostgreSQL, Stripe, Resend or Render.
The build-environment browser check uses in-memory page content because direct localhost browser navigation is blocked.
Physical-device, keyboard, zoom and representative screen-reader retesting remain required after deployment.
This proprietary assessment is not an accredited certification or a guarantee that the system is risk-free.
liveVerificationRequired: Verify /api/ready reports version 10.0.1, production stage, healthy PostgreSQL and migration 008 current.
On Android, open and close the public menu and confirm all navigation links are visible and tappable.
Confirm the support label and email are separated and the email opens the device mail application.
Review homepage, pricing, help, sign-in, dashboard and live protection at phone and desktop widths.
Complete keyboard and representative screen-reader checks before recording the deployment decision.
